title: Thư cuối M3 (mô phỏng, nỉ gần tai)
about: The user asked for a modelled piano instead of a recorded one ("tiếng mô phỏng thay vì tiếng thu âm thật"): dark/piano_model.py makes every note from the physics of its strings (no recording), fitted to the user's choice (H3: its partials note by note, its loudness key by key) and the references' tune. M3: closer, as a felt piano heard near: the hammer's thud and the board, a quicker onset, a smaller room.
